body: Tested locally, it mostly works as expected with both `.res` and `.tres` resources (also as built-in resource within both `.scn` and `.tscn`). Note that the Editor Description section is collapsed by default, so it doesn't take too much space in subresources thankfully: Some issues: - **Binary resources saved with this PR can't be opened in `master` afterwards.** This is not an issue for text-based resources, which still open correctly. - When you use **Make Unique** in the inspector, the editor description is lost.

Works great now 🙂 I can confirm I can still open scenes/resources saved with this PR with 4.5.stable (both text and binary).

I've tested descriptions in `.material`, `.res`, `.tres` and built-in in `.tscn` and `.scn` formats.

Some minor details left, but otherwise looks good now.
Likely needs a core team review.
